# API reference

Every component below is exported from the package root:

```js
import { BaseButton } from 'pickylibrary';
import 'pickylibrary/style.css';
```

`Size` is `'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`. `Color` is `'primary' | 'secondary' |
'success' | 'danger' | 'warning' | 'info' | 'gray'`. Styling hooks -- class names and
data attributes -- are documented in [STYLING.md](STYLING.md).

## BaseAlert

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` **(required)** | `string` |  |  |
| `type` | `'info' \| 'warning' \| 'error' \| 'success'` | `'info'` |  |
| `description` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `dismissible` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `closeLabel` | `string` | `'Close'` | English by default; replace it for your own language. |
| `closeIcon` | `string` | `'xmark'` |  |
| `icon` | `string` |  | Overrides the icon code for this type. Empty leaves the icon out. |

**Events**

- `dismiss`

**Slots**

- `default` — Extra content below the description.
- `icon` — Replaces the icon for this alert type.
- `close-icon` — Replaces the icon inside the close button.

## BaseButton

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `Size` | `'md'` | One of `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the control. |
| `label` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `variant` | `'full' \| 'outline' \| 'text'` | `'full'` |  |
| `color` | `Color \| 'custom'` | `'primary'` |  |
| `htmlType` | `'button' \| 'submit' \| 'reset'` | `'button'` |  |
| `tempLabel` | `string` | `''` | Temporary label after a click, for example "Copied!". |
| `tempLabelDuration` | `number` | `2000` |  |
| `customColor` | `string` |  | Only with color="custom": any CSS colour. Text colour is picked for contrast. |
| `shadow` | `'hard' \| 'soft' \| 'none'` |  | Overrides the shadow style for this button. Without a value the button follows `data-picky-shadow` on an ancestor (`soft` by default). |
| `roundedSide` | `'all' \| 'left' \| 'right' \| 'none'` | `'all'` | Square off one side so buttons can sit flush against each other. |
| `transitionRadius` | `boolean` | `false` | Animate corner-radius changes. Off by default so theme switches are instant. |
| `href` | `string` |  |  |
| `target` | `string` |  |  |
| `rel` | `string` |  |  |

**Events**

- `click` — `event: MouseEvent`

**Slots**

- `default` — Replaces the label. Pass `label` as well, as the accessible name.
- `prefix`
- `suffix`

## BaseIcon

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` **(required)** | `string` |  | Name of the icon, handed to your resolver. |
| `variant` | `string` | `undefined, size: 'md', ratio: 1, label: ''` | Optional style variant (`solid`, `regular`, ...). Only useful if your source has them. |
| `size` | `Size` |  |  |
| `ratio` | `number` |  | Width divided by height. Defaults to 1 (square), which is right for most sets. Font Awesome draws wider than tall on average, so 1.25 gets you the same optical size there. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Gives the icon an accessible name of its own. Without it the icon is decorative (`aria-hidden`) and the name has to come from the surrounding element -- which is the right pattern for an icon inside a button. |

| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` |  |
